title: A clear path from first conversation to launch.
description: You'll work directly with me through each step, with a chance to review the site before it goes live.

steps.title: Tell me about your business
steps.description: We'll discuss your services, your customers, and what visitors should do on the site.

steps.title: Review the direction
steps.description: I'll shape the design and wording around your business, then get your feedback before building.

steps.title: See your site take shape
steps.description: I'll build the approved direction into a mobile-friendly website and prepare it for your review.

steps.title: Review and launch
steps.description: After your final review, I'll connect the domain and put your site live.
